turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: We need a chamber for three days, starting Wednesday if possible. All twelve samples must go through the same run.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: The small chamber’s free Wednesday, but it holds eight. The large one holds sixteen and is booked through Thursday. I can offer a three-day slot starting Friday, either at nine in the morning or at one in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: Our technician can’t check in before noon Friday and has to be there for loading. I can call the engineer from noon, but there’s no phone signal in the loading room.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: I can hold a slot now. Only the engineer can sign the plan, and the person at the loading-room desk has to see it before letting anyone in with samples.

turns.speaker: Woman
turns.text: The customer can see a report only when the project manager has both the chamber data and a signed inspection of the samples. Only our team can sign that inspection.

turns.speaker: Man
turns.text: The system sends the data straight to the manager when the test stops. On your days off the samples can stay inside, but no one else will inspect them.

questions.prompt: Assuming the plan can be approved in time, which booking should the woman request for the test?
options: The smaller chamber on Wednesday, using two separate runs.
The larger chamber on Friday at nine.
The larger chamber on Friday at one.
The larger chamber on Thursday after the technician checks in.

questions.prompt: Which sequence best avoids a delay at the loading room?
options: Enter with the samples, then phone the engineer before loading.
Hold the slot, obtain the engineer’s approval outside the room, and show the signed plan before entering with the samples.
Wait outside until the person at the desk approves the plan, then load the samples.
Hold the slot, show the unsigned draft at the entrance, and obtain approval after the samples are inside.

questions.prompt: If the test finishes while the woman’s team is off, what can happen that day?
options: The manager can review the data, but the customer’s report cannot yet be released.
The customer can receive the report based on the chamber data alone.
The manager must wait for the inspection before receiving any chamber data.
Another team can sign the inspection so the customer gets the report.
